# Ferryx Read-Only Audit: Tab-Close Confirmation Preference

## 1. Executive Summary & Recommended Default

- **Recommendation**: Default to **`false`** (`confirmCloseTab: false` / unconfirmed close by default).
- **Product Convention Rationale**:
  - **Ferryx Core Philosophy**: Ferryx is a lightweight, low-friction terminal & browser developer workspace. Core settings default to frictionless developer flows (e.g., `browserSettings.ts:25` defaults `restoreTabsOnLaunch: false`, `terminalSettings.ts:28` defaults `macosOptionAsAlt: null`/unrestricted, `notificationSettings.ts:18` defaults `terminalBell: false`).
  - **Terminal / Editor Convention**: Modern terminal applications (Ghostty, VS Code, Warp, Arc) do not interrupt standard `Cmd+W` / close clicks with modal prompts by default.
  - **Existing Safety Invariants**: Pinned tabs are already hard-protected against accidental close in `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts:397` and `ui/src/components/tab-dnd/SortableTab.tsx:135` (pin icon hides close button; `closeTab` refuses to close pinned tabs).
  - **Opt-In Safety**: Adding a persistent toggle allows safety-conscious users to opt in without degrading the rapid terminal workflow for all users.

---

## 2. Exact File & Line Evidence

### A. Preferences / Settings Runtime
- **Storage Keys**: `ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts:1-10`
  - Canonical naming standard: `ferryx.settings.<domain>` (e.g., `ferryx.settings.appearance`, `ferryx.settings.browser`, `ferryx.settings.notifications:v1`, `ferryx.terminal.settings`).
  - Storage migration wrapper: `getMigratedItem(key, storage)` at `ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts:22-40`.
- **Domain Settings Hooks & State Modules**:
  - `ui/src/lib/appearanceSettings.ts:14-18, 54-82, 107-130`: `loadAppearanceSettings`, `saveAppearanceSettings`, `resetAppearanceSettings`, `useAppearanceSettings`. Uses `window.dispatchEvent` with `APPEARANCE_SETTINGS_EVENT = "ferryx:appearance-settings"`.
  - `ui/src/lib/browserSettings.ts:14-28, 86-135, 238-265`: `loadBrowserSettings`, `saveBrowserSettings`, `resetBrowserSettings`, `useBrowserSettings`. Uses `BROWSER_SETTINGS_EVENT = "ferryx:browser-settings"`.
  - `ui/src/lib/notificationSettings.ts:5-18, 24-95`: `loadNotificationSettings`, `saveNotificationSettings`, `useNotificationSettings`. Uses `NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS_EVENT = "rorca:notifications:settings-changed"`.
- **Settings Runtime Bridge**: `ui/src/lib/settingsRuntimeBridge.ts:78-132`
  - Listens to DOM `change` events on control IDs (`appearance-theme-mode`, `browser-restore-tabs`, etc.) and `click` on `"Reset to defaults"` buttons to sync settings without polling.

### B. SettingsDialog Structure & Controls
- **Section Routing**: `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:78-87, 151-160, 168-175`
  - `SettingsSection` union contains `"general"`, `"appearance"`, `"terminal"`, `"shortcuts"`, `"workspace"`, `"agents"`, `"browser"`, `"notifications"`, `"remote"`.
- **General Settings Pane**: `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:246-278`
  - `GeneralSettings()` currently renders static overview cards (`settings-general-overview`), making it the natural location for application-wide general shell settings.
- **Form Controls & Layout**:
  - `SettingRow`: `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:1654-1671` (`label`/`title`, `description`, `children`).
  - Standard checkbox controls: `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:447` (Terminal Option as Alt) and `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:802` (`browser-restore-tabs` with `className="size-4 accent-foreground"`).
  - Switch toggles: `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:991-1000` (Notification toggles).
  - Reset action: `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:289-298, 865-873`.

### C. Existing Confirmation Dialog Patterns
- **Worktree Delete Modal**: `ui/src/components/WorktreeDeleteDialog.tsx:110-185`
  - Backdrop: `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm` on `onMouseDown={onClose}`.
  - Dialog: `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="..." className="w-full max-w-lg animate-enter overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-2xl" onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}`.
  - Controls: Cancel button (`rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground`) and Confirm action button (`rounded-md bg-destructive ...` or `bg-primary ...`).
  - Keyboard: `Escape` key listener closes modal.
- **Project Add Modal**: `ui/src/components/ProjectDialogs.tsx:114-140`
  - Modal container: `fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/45` with header icon, title, Cancel and Register buttons.
- **Inline Confirmation**: `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:1122, 1377-1400` (Device revoke inline two-step button).

### D. Tab-Close Command Path
1. **Shortcut Definition**:
   - `ui/src/lib/shortcuts.ts:6, 73-79`: Action ID `"tab.close"`, title `"Close active tab"`, binding `{ key: "w", mod: true }`.
2. **App Command Routing**:
   - `ui/src/App.tsx:192`: Destructures `closeTab` from `useWorkspaceStore`.
   - `ui/src/App.tsx:511-515`: `handleCloseTab = useCallback((tabId: string) => { void closeTab(tabId).catch(reportRuntimeError); }, [closeTab, reportRuntimeError])`.
   - `ui/src/App.tsx:700-703`: Shortcut handler `"tab.close": () => { const activeTabId = stateRef.current.layout.activeTabId; if (activeTabId) handleCloseTab(activeTabId); }`.
   - `ui/src/App.tsx:805-809`: Passes `onCloseTab={handleCloseTab}`, `onCloseOtherTabs={handleCloseOtherTabs}`, `onCloseTabsToRight={handleCloseTabsToRight}`, `onCloseTabsToLeft={handleCloseTabsToLeft}` to `TerminalSplitView`.
3. **Split View & Tab Strip Dispatch**:
   - `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx:414, 609-612`: Passes `onClose={onCloseTab}` to `TabBar`.
   - `ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx:179`: Passes `onClose={onClose}` to `SortableTab`.
   - `ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx:477-484`: Context menu item `"Close tab"` calls `onCloseTab`.
   - `ui/src/components/tab-dnd/SortableTab.tsx:138-144`: Close `X` icon button invokes `onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(tab.id); }}`.
4. **State Teardown (Unconfirmed Execution)**:
   - `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts:393-437`: `closeTab(tabId)` terminates backend PTY session or browser webview, tears down `terminalHostManager` session instance, and dispatches `CLOSE_TAB` reducer action.

## 3. Smallest Schema, Storage, UI, and Behavior Changes

### 1. Schema & Storage Module (`ui/src/lib/generalSettings.ts` & `ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts`)
- **Storage Key**:
  Add `export const GENERAL_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY = "ferryx.settings.general";` to `ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts`.
  Add `[GENERAL_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY]: ["rorca.settings.general", "orca.settings.general"]` to `LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY_MAP`.
- **State Schema**:
  ```ts
  export type GeneralSettingsState = {
    confirmCloseTab: boolean;
  };
  export const DEFAULT_GENERAL_SETTINGS: GeneralSettingsState = {
    confirmCloseTab: false,
  };
  export const GENERAL_SETTINGS_EVENT = "ferryx:general-settings";
  ```
- **Helper Functions**:
  - `loadGeneralSettings(storage?)`: Reads JSON from `GENERAL_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY` via `getMigratedItem`.
  - `saveGeneralSettings(patch, storage?)`: Writes updated JSON and dispatches `CustomEvent(GENERAL_SETTINGS_EVENT)`.
  - `resetGeneralSettings(storage?)`: Removes item and dispatches default event.
  - `useGeneralSettings()`: React hook subscribing to `GENERAL_SETTINGS_EVENT` and `storage` events with `useState(loadGeneralSettings)`.

### 2. SettingsDialog UI (`ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx`)
- In `GeneralSettings()` (`ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:246`):
  - Call `const { settings, updateSettings, resetSettings } = useGeneralSettings();`.
  - Add a `"Reset to defaults"` button in the section header.
  - Add a `SettingRow`:
    ```tsx
    <SettingRow
      label="Confirm before closing tab"
      description="Ask for confirmation before closing a terminal or browser tab."
    >
      <input
        id="general-confirm-close-tab"
        aria-label="Confirm before closing tab"
        type="checkbox"
        checked={settings.confirmCloseTab}
        onChange={(e) => updateSettings({ confirmCloseTab: e.target.checked })}
        className="size-4 accent-foreground"
      />
    </SettingRow>
    ```

### 3. Confirmation Dialog Component (`ui/src/components/ConfirmCloseTabDialog.tsx`)
- Lightweight modal matching `WorktreeDeleteDialog` tokens:
  - Props: `{ open: boolean; tabLabel: string; onConfirm: () => void; onClose: () => void }`.
  - Accessible attributes: `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Confirm close tab"`.
  - Title: "Close Tab", Body: "Are you sure you want to close \"{tabLabel}\"?", Buttons: "Cancel" (`hover:bg-accent`) and "Close" (`bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground`).

### 4. Behavior Interception (`ui/src/App.tsx`)
- In `App.tsx`:
  - Hook: `const { settings: generalSettings } = useGeneralSettings();`
  - State: `const [tabPendingClose, setTabPendingClose] = useState<{ id: string; label: string } | null>(null);`
  - Update `handleCloseTab`:
    ```ts
    const handleCloseTab = useCallback((tabId: string) => {
      const tab = stateRef.current.layout.tabs.find((t) => t.id === tabId);
      if (!tab || tab.pinned) return;
      if (generalSettings.confirmCloseTab) {
        setTabPendingClose({ id: tab.id, label: tab.label });
      } else {
        void closeTab(tabId).catch(reportRuntimeError);
      }
    }, [closeTab, generalSettings.confirmCloseTab, reportRuntimeError]);
    ```
  - Render modal conditionally:
    ```tsx
    {tabPendingClose ? (
      <ConfirmCloseTabDialog
        open={true}
        tabLabel={tabPendingClose.label}
        onClose={() => setTabPendingClose(null)}
        onConfirm={() => {
          const tabId = tabPendingClose.id;
          setTabPendingClose(null);
          void closeTab(tabId).catch(reportRuntimeError);
        }}
      />
    ) : null}
    ```

---

## 4. Deterministic Failing-First Test Plan

### Step 1: Storage & Runtime Unit Tests (`ui/src/lib/settingsRuntime.test.ts` & `ui/src/lib/storageKeys.test.ts`)
- **RED Test 1 (`storageKeys.test.ts`)**:
  Assert `GENERAL_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY` starts with `"ferryx."` and `getMigratedItem` migrates `rorca.settings.general` to `ferryx.settings.general`.
- **RED Test 2 (`settingsRuntime.test.ts`)**:
  - `loadGeneralSettings()` returns `{ confirmCloseTab: false }` on empty storage.
  - `saveGeneralSettings({ confirmCloseTab: true })` writes to localStorage and dispatches `ferryx:general-settings` custom event.
  - `resetGeneralSettings()` restores `confirmCloseTab: false`.

### Step 2: SettingsDialog Component Tests (`ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx`)
- **RED Test 3**:
  - Render `<SettingsDialog open={true} />`.
  - Locate `screen.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /confirm before closing tab/i })`.
  - Expect `checked === false` by default.
  - Click checkbox -> expect `loadGeneralSettings().confirmCloseTab === true`.
  - Click "Reset to defaults" -> expect checkbox `checked === false`.

### Step 3: App Close-Tab Interception & Modal Contract (`ui/src/App.test.tsx`)
- **RED Test 4 (Default behavior - unconfirmed close)**:
  - Mock `generalSettings = { confirmCloseTab: false }`.
  - Trigger `shortcutHandlers["tab.close"]` or click tab close button.
  - Assert `workspace.closeTab` is called immediately without rendering any confirmation dialog.
- **RED Test 5 (Enabled preference - confirmed close)**:
  - Save `saveGeneralSettings({ confirmCloseTab: true })`.
  - Trigger `shortcutHandlers["tab.close"]` for active tab `"tab-1"` labeled `"main"`.
  - Assert `workspace.closeTab` is **not** called yet.
  - Assert `screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: /confirm close tab/i })` is visible in the DOM.
  - Click "Cancel" -> modal disappears, `workspace.closeTab` has 0 calls.
  - Trigger `tab.close` again -> click "Close" in dialog -> modal disappears, `workspace.closeTab` called with `"tab-1"`.

---

## 5. Verification Gate Summary

- **Single Domain Behavioral Scope**: UI and settings layer.
- **Deterministic**: No `setTimeout` polling; uses discrete DOM event dispatches, React state transitions, and mocked storage.
- **Seam Completeness**: The path from `storageKeys.ts` → `generalSettings.ts` → `SettingsDialog.tsx` → `App.tsx` → `ConfirmCloseTabDialog.tsx` → `workspaceStore.closeTab` is fully traced and unambiguous.
